hippocampal_buffer.raw_text: It is too early to get up, and the house is quiet. I wonder if Kai is sleeping well.
The house is so quiet right now, I can almost hear the dust settling. I wonder if Kai slept through the night or if he is tossing and turning again.
The quiet is heavy this morning. I hope Kai is sleeping peacefully and not tossing and turning again. I should just stay still for a moment and let the day begin.
Vikram is still asleep, so I won't wake him. I just need a moment to breathe before the day starts.
The light is just starting to creep in, and the house feels still. I wonder if Kai is finally resting easy this morning. I’ll just sit here for a minute and listen to the quiet.
Vikram is still asleep, so I won't wake him. I just need a moment to breathe before the day starts.
The light is hitting the window pane in a way that makes the dust look like gold. I wonder if Kai is still resting or if he has woken up to the day.
The light is getting brighter now, and Vikram is still breathing deep next to me. I hope Kai is up and has had his breakfast by now.
The light is catching the dust motes in a way that looks almost like gold. I should check on Kai's fencing practice later and see if the new moves are sticking.
The light is still catching those dust motes, almost like gold dust. I wonder if Kai is up yet, or if he's still sleeping in. I'll just stay here for a moment and listen to Vikram breathe.
The morning air feels crisp today. I hope Kai has eaten his breakfast before heading out. I should get up and see to the kitchen soon.
Half-noticed: I walked into the kitchen to start the morning.
The spices are blooming nicely in the pan. I wonder if Kai ate his breakfast before heading out. I'll just keep the heat steady and let the morning settle.

style.stress_strong: Under heavy strain right now: phrasing comes out simpler and more fragmented, with restarts, pauses and fillers.

style.length_longer: You tend to ramble a bit more than usual.
style.tired: Very tired right now: flatter in feeling and slower to respond.
style.first_person: Low in mood: you talk about yourself ("I", "me") a little more than usual.
